# `adt source`

Read and write ABAP source code

```bash
adt source [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command               | Description                                               |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `adt source get`      | Print ABAP source code for an object to stdout            |
| `adt source put`      | Write ABAP source code from a file to an existing object  |
| `adt source versions` | List immutable source-version metadata for an ABAP object |
| `adt source version`  | Operate on one immutable source version                   |

## `adt source get`

Print ABAP source code for an object to stdout

```bash
adt source get [options] <objectName>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument       | Description      | Default |
| -------------- | ---------------- | ------- |
| `<objectName>` | ABAP object name |         |

**Options**

| Option                | Description                                           | Default   |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | --------- |
| `--type <type>`       | Object type hint (e.g. CLAS, PROG, INTF)              |           |
| `--version <version>` | Source version (active or inactive)                   |           |
| `--include <include>` | Source include/section (e.g. testclasses, localtypes) |           |
| `--method <method>`   | Method name to read, or * to list methods             |           |
| `--grep <pattern>`    | Search source with regex context                      |           |
| `--max-bytes <bytes>` | Maximum source bytes to retrieve                      | `1048576` |
| `--format <format>`   | Output format (raw or structured)                     | `raw`     |
| `--json`              | Output result as JSON                                 |           |

## `adt source put`

Write ABAP source code from a file to an existing object

```bash
adt source put [options] <objectName> <file>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument       | Description                       | Default |
| -------------- | --------------------------------- | ------- |
| `<objectName>` | ABAP object name                  |         |
| `<file>`       | Path to the source file to upload |         |

**Options**

| Option                    | Description                                                          | Default     |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- |
| `--type <type>`           | Object type hint (e.g. CLAS, PROG, INTF)                             |             |
| `--transport <transport>` | Transport request number for transportable objects                   |             |
| `--method <method>`       | Replace the body of a single method instead of uploading full source |             |
| `--lint-before-write`     | Run local lint checks and block write on parser/cloud violations     | `false`     |
| `--lint-preset <preset>`  | Lint preset for --lint-before-write gate: btp\|onpremise             | `onpremise` |
| `--json`                  | Output result as JSON                                                |             |

## `adt source versions`

List immutable source-version metadata for an ABAP object

```bash
adt source versions [options] <object>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument   | Description      | Default |
| ---------- | ---------------- | ------- |
| `<object>` | ABAP object name |         |

**Options**

| Option               | Description                                   | Default |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--type <type>`      | ADT object type (for example CLAS) (required) |         |
| `--component <name>` | Exact source component id                     |         |
| `--json`             | Output normalized metadata as JSON            |         |

## `adt source version`

Operate on one immutable source version

```bash
adt source version [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command                  | Description                                  |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------- |
| `adt source version get` | Read one immutable historical source version |

### `adt source version get`

Read one immutable historical source version

```bash
adt source version get [options]
```

**Options**

| Option                  | Description                                                         | Default |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--uri <immutable-uri>` | Immutable server-relative ADT source URI returned by SAP (required) |         |
| `--output <file>`       | Write source to a file, or '-' for stdout                           | `-`     |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
